# Runners Connect

> Runners Connect is a comprehensive running coaching platform offering personalized training plans, nutrition guidance, and strength training programs led by expert coaches including Jeff Gaudette and Ruairi Moynihan.

Runners Connect combines personalized coaching with structured training programs and educational resources to help runners of all levels improve performance, prevent injury, and achieve their race goals. The platform emphasizes evidence-based training approaches and individualized nutrition planning.

## Key Topics

- Personalized Training Plans
- Marathon Training
- Strength Training for Runners
- Running Nutrition
- Injury Prevention
- Running Form & Biomechanics
- Jeff Gaudette
- Coaching Philosophy
- Weight Loss
- Running Community
- 6-Week Bootcamps
- Marathon Nutrition Blueprint
- Exercise Physiology
- Running Performance

## Training Programs & Plans

- [Training Plans](https://runnersconnect.net/training-plans): Personalized training plans for races, health and fitness improvement
- [Focus - 6-Week Bootcamps](https://runnersconnect.net/focus): 6-week bootcamps for strength, speed, weight loss and mileage building
- [Marathon Nutrition Blueprint](https://runnersconnect.net/marathon-nutrition-blueprint): Individualized marathon nutrition plan to prevent hitting the wall

## Education & Training Guides

- [Nutrition for Runners](https://runnersconnect.net/nutrition-for-runners): Guide to runner nutrition for performance, weight loss and marathon training
- [Strength Training for Runners](https://runnersconnect.net/strength-training-runners): Strength training guide for injury prevention and running performance
- [Improve Running Form](https://runnersconnect.net/improve-running-form): Online course on running form, biomechanics and efficiency drills

## About Runners Connect

- [The RC Story](https://runnersconnect.net/the-rc-story): Runners Connect story, mission, values and coaching approach
- [About Us](https://runnersconnect.net/about-us): Company mission and coaching philosophy of Runners Connect
- [Meet Your Coaches](https://runnersconnect.net/running-coaches): Meet expert coaching team including Jeff Gaudette and Ruairi Moynihan
